physicalNotes: Radius 0.79 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Hebrard et al. 2013, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-52 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...549A.134H/abstract): 549,603 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 5000 +/- 100 K from Hebrard et al. 2013, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-52 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...549A.134H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
